condition: Both components must improve primary robust Macro-F1 and primary robust MAE relative to their controlled reference; choose the qualifying shape with lower six-profile J; at most one combination.
uncertainty: Report source-video paired bootstrap intervals and seed variation; point improvements are exploratory if intervals include zero.
formal_selection: All seven historical guardrails must pass; lowest six-profile J, within .002 prefer fewer total deployed parameters; otherwise keep old_gated.
test: After final validation selection lock only; historical test has already been seen in earlier experiments.
